text: Training target: This major has the basic knowledge and basic ability in basic medicine, clinical medicine, medical examination and so on. It can be a senior specialist in medical laboratory and medical laboratory at all levels of hospital, blood station and epidemic prevention department. Students should master basic theory knowledge and experimental operation ability in basic medicine, clinical medicine, medical examination, experimental diagnosis and so on. At the same time, they should master the knowledge of natural science and Humanities and social sciences. After graduation, he can engage in clinical laboratory medicine, laboratory teaching and scientific research. Knowledge skills: Students should acquire the following knowledge and ability; 1. Basic theoretical knowledge and experimental skills in medical chemistry, medical physics and basic medicine; 2. Basic knowledge of clinical diagnosis of disease; 3. Basic theoretical knowledge and experimental operation skills of clinical medical examination; 4. Basic knowledge and skills of mathematical statistics and computer application; 5. The structure and operation skills of various commonly used medical analysis instruments; 6. Basic knowledge and skills related to health related tests; 7. Have the preliminary ability of clinical medical laboratory research. Major courses: Organic chemistry, inorganic chemistry, biochemistry, biochemistry, molecular biology, medical statistics, analytical chemistry, laboratory instrumentation, physiology, pathology, systemic anatomy, local anatomy, parasitology and test, microbiology and test, immunology and test, hematology test, clinical biochemistry, Test, clinical transfusion and test, clinical basic test, medical English, diagnostics, internal medicine, surgery, obstetrics and Gynecology, pediatrics, infectious diseases, pharmacology, computer basis and application. Intership: Including clinical practice, graduation practice, generally arranged for 48 weeks. Duration: 5 years
